evidence: The thickness, density and surface roughness of the ﬁlms were determined by the X-ray reﬂection (XRR) while the crystal structure was characterized by grazing incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXRD) method. The mass thickness and impurity content of the ﬁlms were measured by X-ray ﬂuorescence (XRF) spectroscopy. The root mean square (RMS) roughness was determined also by the atomic force microscopy (AFM) using Autoprobe CP II (Veeco Instruments Inc.) equipment and silicon cantilevers with typical tip radii of≤10 nm. ... For electrical characterization of ATO, circular top electrodes with diameters of 0.05, 0.25 and 0.50 mm were prepared by electron beam evaporation of Pt through a shadow mask on the ﬁlms that were grown on RuO2. After evaporation of the top electrodes, the samples were annealed in oxygen at 300 °C for 15 min. Capacitance was measured at frequencies of 1 kHz –1 MHz with Agilent 4284A LCR Meter.
